aboutGame.title: What is be a youtuber?
paragraphs: be a youtuber is a Roblox creator-simulation experience created by the Roblox user Majicos_official. Players start as a small creator with basic gear, record and upload videos, gain subscribers and views, earn in-game money, and work toward an advertised goal of one million subscribers.

The official description advertises upgrades for microphones, cameras, gaming PCs, and streaming studios, and frames the goal as becoming the top YouTuber on the server. The description does not document codes, item names, prices, studio tiers, subscriber thresholds, or control schemes.

items.question: What is be a youtuber?
items.answer: be a youtuber is a Roblox creator-simulation experience created by the Roblox user Majicos_official. Players start as a small creator with basic gear, record and upload videos, gain subscribers and views, earn in-game money, and upgrade equipment with an advertised goal of one million subscribers.

items.question: How do you earn money in be a youtuber?
items.answer: The official description states that you earn money from your videos. It does not document specific payout amounts or speeds.

items.question: Are there working codes for be a youtuber?
items.answer: The official Roblox description does not document a code system, so no working codes can be confirmed. Any codes page here is an overview of that fact, not a list of verified codes.

items.question: Which equipment upgrades does be a youtuber advertise?
items.answer: The official description advertises upgrades for microphones, cameras, gaming PCs, and streaming studios. It does not document specific item names or prices.

items.question: How do subscribers affect progression in be a youtuber?
items.answer: Subscribers and views are advertised as core progression stats, with a stated goal of one million subscribers. Exact subscriber thresholds for rewards or unlocks are not documented in the official description.
